name: EU Lower Exposure Action Value (LEX,8h)
source: Directive 2003/10/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 February 2003 on the minimum health and safety requirements regarding the exposure of workers to the risks arising from physical agents (noise), Article 3(1)(c): lower exposure action values LEX,8h = 80 dB(A). Official Journal L 42, 15.2.2003, p. 38-44.

name: EU Upper Exposure Action Value (LEX,8h)
source: Directive 2003/10/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 February 2003 on the minimum health and safety requirements regarding the exposure of workers to the risks arising from physical agents (noise), Article 3(1)(b): upper exposure action values LEX,8h = 85 dB(A). Official Journal L 42, 15.2.2003, p. 38-44.
